tool.name: Zip files
tool.description: matching a name pattern or extension
tool.command: set -o pipefail && mkdir zip_folder && #for $f in $inputs #if $file_filter.filter == "all_files" or $file_filter.pattern == $f.ext ln -s '$f' 'zip_folder/${f.element_identifier}.${f.ext}' && #end if #end for cd zip_folder && find . -print | zip archive --names-stdin && cd .. && mv zip_folder/archive.zip '$output'

param.name: inputs
param.label: Input collection
param.help: Select the collection whose elements you want to zip

param.name: filter
param.label: Select which files add to archieve

param.name: pattern
param.label: Files extension patterns
param.help: Select datatype according to the supported Galaxy data types

tool.help:
**What it does**
Create a ZIP file from a collection input.
**File selection options**
1) *All files in the collection*: ZIP all files in the collection creating a single bundle 2) *Filter by data type*: ZIP just files a specific extension
